{{Quote|&hellip;it was an Imperial ship, of outdated design. It jumped in-system and began firing.|Lord [[Senu]]|<ref name="Flashpoint: Red Reaper" />}}
The '''''Red Reaper''''' was an Imperial [[Dreadnaught/Legends|Dreadnaught]] that served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], under the command of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Ikoral]]. Commissioned around [[3712 BBY]] by the [[Dark Council]] for Ikoral's expedition in search of [[Sith (species)/Legends|pureblood]] Sith, the ship was not seen until almost 70 years later. The ship was destroyed, along with its master, at the [[Battle of the Red Reaper]].
